name: chown-file
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: writes a file and gives it a non-root owner, so a system file under /etc ends up owned (and rewritable) by an ordinary account. Vars: FILE_PATH (required); OWNER (required); CONTENT (optional).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${FILE_PATH:?FILE_PATH is required}"
: "${OWNER:?OWNER is required}"
install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$FILE_PATH")"
printf '%s\n' "${CONTENT-}" > "$FILE_PATH"
chown "$OWNER" "$FILE_PATH"
